text:
sam: quick follow-up from the auth RFC: propose we shrink internal svc JWTs to only {sub, route, verbs, exp, schema} and move tenant/project into a signed header blob. big win: smaller tokens -> higher gateway cache hit rate + fewer introspects.

ana: sounds good. is this only for svc->svc?

sam: yes, internal only initially. public API keys unchanged for compatibility.

lee: how do we handle endpoints that need full role lists?

sam: two options: on-demand introspect (cold path) or mint a short-lived expanded token from the existing mint service when route metadata marks it `needs_roles`.

ana: audit/tracing? header needs correlation id paired with token.

sam: include `X-RW-Org`, `X-RW-Project`, `X-RW-Corr`. gateway logs both token id and corr id for linking.

lee: security: gateway must strip inbound X-RW-* from external requests and only accept signed envelopes from mTLS peers. verify signature with KMS.

ops-bot: Created ticket RWINF-7581: https://tickets.redwood.example/RWINF-7581

ana: next steps: sam to draft header blob format + mint endpoint path, and add SDK lint to flag `token.roles` access.

sam: will send a short PR today.
